title: Hanalei Surfboard House

services.name: Hanalei Surfboard House
services.desc: Within walking distance from the heart of Hanalei town, our stylish accommodation provides an ideal way to experience a flavor of island lifestyle in an intimate setting. Tucked away on the beachfront road directly across from the Pine Trees section of surfer-acclaimed Hanalei Bay, we have some of the only self-contained single suites available in this charming village. Vintage surfboards line our fenced-in property, reflecting fifty years of artisanship and history that have made our locale somewhat of a neighborhood icon. Lush gardens cover the property grounds and your private lanai (patio), displaying tropical flowers, fountains, blossoming orchids, and antique lawn
